author: GamingBolt
description:
Burning Sword Death Sun is an interesting title to dive into when you’re coming off a lot of time in Phantom Blade Zero’s Wulin. The wuxia inspirations are equally tangible in this Early Access debut of an interesting journey, and the combat comes with strong foundations that have us quite excited to see how the developers build on it.

There are issues, such as pop-in, performance drops, and some very imbalanced upgrade costs, but they’re likely to fade away to the back of your mind the moment you encounter an enemy and draw your blade. That’s a win in our book, and this one’s a fine addition to the year’s lineup of great action games. We dive into why in this review of a strong debut, and the beginning of a journey we hope turns into something special.
title: Burning Sword: Death Sun Feels Like A Fiery Alternative to Phantom Blade Zero

author: GamingBolt
description:
In the year Xbox celebrates its 25th anniversary, the brand finds itself at something of a crossroads. Phil Spencer has left after 12 years spearheading Microsoft’s gaming division. Then Xbox president Sarah Bond also departed, with Asha Sharma appointed as the new CEO of Microsoft Gaming. 

Matt Booty was also promoted to Executive Vice President and Chief Content Officer, and together the pair are overseeing a significant change of operations, with Sharma notably pledging to recommit the brand back toward its core fanbase.
title: Xbox Series X | S Six Years Later - What Went Wrong?

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’re enjoying GTA 6 a lot, so much so that it is taking over every second of free time we can afford to give it, and we couldn’t be more excited to join the lot of you on Leonida’s streets, uncovering everything that makes it tick, and even some of what it tries to hide away. 

The thing is, a lot of that is going to need cash, which can be hard to come by in the game’s early hours when Jason and Lucia are still building up their reputation as effective operators on the city’s underground crime circuit. 

However, Leonida’s nothing if not a place of opportunity for those enterprising enough to get out and get what they want. We’ve got a few places you could look to if you’re in need of some quick money, so strap in and learn more about how to keep your inflows higher than your outflows in this one.
title: GTA 6 - 10 FASTEST Ways To Make Money
